rows.grounds: compound naming siddhi attainment and mūlakaula

items.question: What eightfold attainment of siddhi is identified with mūlakaula, O fair-faced one?
premises: Siddhi attainment is linked to mūlakaula.
items.inference: The verse names eight as the siddhi attainment tied to mūlakaula.
uncertainties: Exact syntactic role of the compound remains unclear.
items.plain_english: And eight, O fair-faced one, is the attainment of siddhi, mūlakaula.
